title: Evaluation law for a normalized comparison
statement: For any normalized Comparison c for an isomorphism of schemes, the reindexed tensor and derived Hom maps satisfy the displayed evaluation equation for every pair of derived objects.

proof.text: For K-flat P and K-injective I choose a K-flat resolution A → Hom(P,I). Its localized map followed by the inverse fixed Hom model is an isomorphism A_Q → RHom(P_Q,I_Q). This lets us test the desired evaluation equality after the tensor of that isomorphism and the identity of P_Q.

Use the ordinary chain tensor-Hom equivalence to uncurry A → Hom(P,I). On reindexing, the Hom projection equation chain_projection and the tensor-generator equation tensorChain_pure identify both chain maps on every pure tensor. Sheafification and total-complex extensionality prove equality of the chain maps.

Apply coefficientTensorCurry_normalize on both sites to the chain maps. The fixed K-injective Hom model is precisely the augmentation expression in that theorem. Combine these two equations with tensor_model, derived_model, and naturality of podReindexingDerivedFactors. Naturality of the closed counit in both variables cancels the representative isomorphisms and proves the evaluation law for P_Q and I_Q.

Every derived M is isomorphic to the localization of a K-flat resolution, and every derived N to that of a K-injective resolution. Transport the representative evaluation equality along these isomorphisms, using the tensor and Hom comparison naturality and the two-variable evaluation identity of the closed structure.

proof_origin.place: Step 4; componentwise tensor-Hom normalization and transport along resolutions, implemented in Lean.

Only abstract closed-category lemmas match; none includes the project normalization.

lean.statement: theorem comparison_evaluation_law {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ) (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s) (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY) (c : Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY) : ∀ M N : podReindexingDerived l E Y s, c.tensor.hom.app ((podReindexingDerivedHom l E Y s).obj (op M, N), M) ≫ SX.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (c.derived.hom.app (op M, N)) (𝟙 ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj M))) ≫ SX.evaluation ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj M) ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj N) = (podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).map (SY.evaluation M N)
